details: The United States indicates that a deal on reopening the Strait of Hormuz is close, following "positive" talks between Iran and Oman. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio confirmed progress in negotiations. This development suggests easing tensions in a critical global oil transit choke point.
title: US and Iran Nearing Deal on Strait of Hormuz Reopening

details: The European Union has adopted its 21st package of restrictive measures against Russia, significantly expanding actions against its financial and banking sector and explicitly targeting crypto-asset services. For the first time, the EU introduces the possibility of a full third-country ban for crypto-asset services to deter countries hosting platforms that help Russia evade sanctions. The package imposes asset freezes and prohibits making funds available to 94 banks and major financial institutions, extends transaction bans to 33 additional Russian credit and financial institutions, and includes 14 crypto-related service platforms in various countries.
title: EU Imposes 21st Package of Sanctions on Russia, Targeting Crypto
